_help: Edit this file to teach the skill a new kind of file. Rules are tried in order; the first category whose pattern matches wins. A pattern without '/' is matched against the file name, with '/' against the whole path from the project root. 'dest' is the folder the file belongs in ('' = project root); {skill} is filled with the skill name.

categories.label: Claude Code skill
categories.note: Skills must live in .claude/skills/<skill-name>/ for Claude Code to find them. Their scripts and references stay inside that folder.
